lines.en: Hi. I want to open a new account.
lines.zh: 你好，我想開一個新帳戶。

lines.en: Sure. Do you have your ID with you?
lines.zh: 好的。您有帶身分證嗎？

lines.en: No, I left it at home. Can I use my card?
lines.zh: 沒有，我放在家裡了。我可以用我的卡嗎？

lines.en: Sorry, I need your ID. Please come back tomorrow.
lines.zh: 抱歉，我需要您的身分證。請明天再來。

lines.en: OK. I will bring it in the morning.
lines.zh: 好，我明天早上帶來。

questions.en: What does the bank ask the person to show?
questions.zh: 銀行要求這個人出示什麼？

questions.en: When will the person come back?

lines.en: Excuse me. I can't find this book.
lines.zh: 不好意思，我找不到這本書。

lines.en: Let me check. Someone borrowed it yesterday.
lines.zh: 我查一下。昨天有人借走了。

lines.en: When will it be back?
lines.zh: 它什麼時候會還回來？

lines.en: On Friday. I can put your name on a list.
lines.zh: 星期五。我可以把您的名字放在名單上。

lines.en: Yes, please. Thank you.
lines.zh: 好的，麻煩你了。謝謝。

questions.en: Why can't the person find the book?
questions.zh: 這個人為什麼找不到這本書？

options: Put a name on a list

lines.en: The sink in my kitchen is leaking.
lines.zh: 我廚房的水槽漏水。

lines.en: Since when?
lines.zh: 從什麼時候開始的？

lines.en: Since last night. There is water on the floor.
lines.zh: 從昨晚開始。地板上有水。

lines.en: I will send a plumber at ten tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我明天十點會派一位水電師傅過去。

lines.en: Thanks. I will be home.
lines.zh: 謝謝。我會在家。

questions.zh: 水電師傅什麼時候會來？

lines.en: Welcome. Your first day starts at eight on Monday.
lines.zh: 歡迎。您的第一天在星期一八點開始。

lines.en: Do I need to bring anything?
lines.zh: 我需要帶什麼東西嗎？

lines.en: Just your lunch. We will give you a work shirt.
lines.zh: 帶午餐就好。我們會給您一件工作襯衫。

lines.en: Great. Where can I park?
lines.zh: 太好了。我可以把車停在哪裡？

lines.en: Behind the office. Come to the front desk first.
lines.zh: 在辦公室後面。請先到櫃台來。

questions.en: What should the new employee bring?
Where can the new employee park?
questions.zh: 員工可以把車停在哪裡？

lines.en: I want to find a job near my home.
lines.zh: 我想在家附近找一份工作。

lines.en: What can you do?
lines.zh: 您會做什麼？

lines.en: I can cook, and I speak some English.
lines.zh: 我會煮菜，也會說一點英文。

lines.en: Good. A restaurant needs a cook. Here is the address.
lines.zh: 很好。有間餐廳需要廚師。這是地址。

lines.en: Thank you. I will go there this afternoon.
lines.zh: 謝謝你。我今天下午就過去。

questions.en: What job does the counselor suggest?
questions.zh: 就業顧問建議什麼工作？

questions.en: When will the person go to the restaurant?
questions.zh: 這個人什麼時候會去餐廳？

lines.en: Hi, I want to join your English class.
lines.zh: 嗨，我想參加你們的英文課。

lines.en: It meets every Tuesday at six. It is ten dollars.
lines.zh: 每個星期二六點上課。費用是十元。

lines.en: Can I pay now?
lines.zh: 我可以現在付款嗎？

lines.en: You can pay at the desk. Please bring a bag.
lines.zh: 可以到櫃台付款。請帶一個袋子。

lines.en: OK. I will get one today.
lines.zh: 好，我今天就去準備一個。

questions.en: How often does the class meet?

lines.en: My car makes a strange noise.
lines.zh: 我的車發出奇怪的聲音。

lines.en: Let me look. The tire is old.
lines.zh: 我看看。輪胎很舊了。

lines.en: Can you fix it today?
lines.zh: 你今天能修好嗎？

lines.en: No, I need a new tire. It will be ready on Thursday.
lines.zh: 不行，我需要一個新輪胎。星期四就會好。

lines.en: OK. I will come and get it then.
lines.zh: 好，我到時候來取車。

questions.en: What is wrong with the car?
When will the car be ready?

lines.en: Good morning. Do you have an interview today?
lines.zh: 早安。您今天有面試嗎？

lines.en: Yes, with Ms. Lin at nine.
lines.zh: 有，九點和 Lin 小姐面試。

lines.en: Please sign here and wait. She is in a meeting.
lines.zh: 請在這裡簽名並稍等。她正在開會。

lines.en: How long should I wait?
lines.zh: 我該等多久？

lines.en: About ten minutes. Please sit over there.
lines.zh: 大約十分鐘。請坐在那邊。

options: Ms. Lin is in a meeting

questions.en: How long will the person wait?
